thresholds.offers: every offer settles inside flood+15 s; only real HTTP answers count — a tcp reset is a failure
thresholds.legit_floor: at least 4 offers get a real HTTP 200 during the flood — nonzero service proves rotation (measured 7 at this shape)
thresholds.health: 200 on the dedicated listener, every probe <500 ms
thresholds.recovery: 40 submits served <5 s after the flood

note: a conn hoard must not wedge work or liveness: reserve + slot rotation; tcp refusals are failures, not answers
